name: Primary Energy Efficiency Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: The official product page states that after the release of TSG R0010-2019, Heat Exchanger Energy Efficiency Testing and Evaluation Rules, THT Juyuan had eight plate series tested and evaluated by the National Heat Exchange Product Quality Supervision and Inspection Center and meeting Level-1 energy-efficiency requirements for high-efficiency plate heat exchangers: Y5F, Y10B, P15B(H), Y15B, S15B-H, P15G-Z, Y20B, and P45A-H. The company also identifies itself as one of the drafting units of NB/T47004.1-2017 Plate Heat Exchanger.
advantage: Eight listed plate series meet Level-1 energy-efficiency requirements.
Officially connected with NB/T47004.1-2017 plate heat exchanger standard drafting.
The page highlights corrugation design and gasket fixing/sealing improvements for transfer efficiency and reliability.

technical_parameters.Level-1 Energy-Efficiency Plate Series: Y5F, Y10B, P15B(H), Y15B, S15B-H, P15G-Z, Y20B, P45A-H

details.title: What makes it different?
